liveExperiments.extractionPolicy: Literal values and nonempty exact spans are transcribed from frozen candidate answers, then compared with frozen gold by code. Filters require exact filterSpans or the exact frozen row set evidenced in candidate answer/citations; extra or contradictory asserted filters still fail. Row-based filter fulfillment concerns the selected result, not proof of hidden query execution. Missing provenance fails its dimension. This checks audited requested results, not exhaustive numeric claim coverage or semantic truth.

live.reason: Sanitized client runtime telemetry does not establish token usage, upstream retries, deployed provider configuration or price. No inference from characters, durations or logical counts.

localControlled.limitation: No live provider in this lane; local callback work is not billed model usage.

live.measurement: Persisted user-to-assistant timestamps; buffering and service time included. UI bridge delays between requests excluded. Shared workspace warms sequentially; only the first request is cold. Statistics describe observations, not independent repetitions.

proposedGates.status: proposal; not a claim that the current baseline passes
proposedGates.basis: User-specified invariants; recorded after baseline without production tuning.

hardGates.requiredEvidence: complete access trace plus output/source audit against two project roots
real add/delete sync, layer/store invalidation and subsequent QMD/query results
static boundary tests and complete application network trace
actual Side Chat completion, persisted recommendation before/after, including a seeded non-null recommendation
actual filesystem/IPC tests including symlinks and complete agent tool access audit
all gold values, units, source rows, filters, grouping and operations; unresolved primitive answers fail
controlled source transitions with actual filesystem and derived-index/store state

proposedGates.unknownPolicy: Missing required evidence is unknown and cannot pass a release gate.
proposedGates.qualityPolicy: Report paired case-cluster deltas and confidence intervals separately by primary/stress domain, language and split. No justified noninferiority margin is established by this small first baseline. Pre-register margins and representative live repeats before the next comparison.
proposedGates.pairwisePolicy: Blind randomized A/B labels; record evaluated cases and independent judge samples. Zero comparisons yields null win/tie rates.
proposedGates.costPolicy: Use measured FC transport attempts and provider usage, with role-separated logical counts. Controlled-provider zero usage cannot estimate live dollar cost.
